reviews.title: Happy first time builder!
reviews.comment: The Montech XR Wood offers a simple but classy design with the wood accents. Access throughout the entire case is easy and makes building a PC a clean experience. The open panel design allowed a novice/first time builder such as me to smoothly add my PC components. I like the magnetic vent covers although they can fall off easily with minimal manipulation or a brush against them so be aware when handling the case. Also, the fan cords can be a bit tight in binding so don't pull too tight.  Overall, the case has plenty of options for adding extra storage such as HDDs, SSDs and M.2. and has good airflow throughout.
reviews.author: Hamp

reviews.title: Great case for the money
reviews.comment: Great case and I have nothing wrong about it. It came assembled and it was easy to pop off the front panel and back panel. The cooling is good and the fans are able to keep my PC cool. I run a 5070TI and a 7800x3d.
reviews.author: Matthew
